## Workload

During the review period, grader Hannah Lowe recorded 445 reads over 278 hours. This represents a rate of 1.6 reads per hour. The workload was documented for review by Priya Anand, with the recorded hours and reading activity considered together to provide a clear account of throughput.

## Quality

A total of 39 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 53.8. The review identified the need for feedback on borderline background cases. Priya Anand reviewed the work and considered both the checking activity and the agreement result in assessing quality.
